programs.name: One Phase
programs.drawdown_type: static (6% of initial balance; equity may not fall below it)
programs.consistency_rule: 40% in the challenge: best day may be at most 40% of total profit (equity-based). No consistency rule on funded accounts
programs.profit_split: 80%; 90% with the paid '90% Performance Reward' add-on (+20% of fee; +$63.80 on the 50K at checkout)
programs.payout_frequency: bi-weekly (every 14 days); first reward 14 days after funding, or 7 days with the paid 'First Reward in 7 Days' add-on
programs.payout_rules_note: At least $100 profit needed before any reward request. Challenge fee credited back with the first reward. FunderPro says it aims to process funded rewards within 1 working day of approval.
programs.notes: Leverage 1:50 forex, 1:10 metals/oil/indices, 1:2 crypto. Daily loss is 3% of the balance at the start of the trading day (5 PM EST snapshot). Checkout (seen 2026-10-19) shows $319.00 for this 50K configuration with no strikethrough price. Weekend holding only with the Swing add-on.

programs.name: Classic (2-Phase)
programs.profit_split: 80%; 90% with the paid '90% Performance Reward' add-on
programs.payout_frequency: bi-weekly (every 14 days); first reward 14 days after funding, or 7 days with the paid add-on
programs.payout_rules_note: At least $100 profit needed before any reward request. Challenge fee credited back with the first reward (within 7 days of the first reward withdrawal). 'No Minimum Trading Days' and 'Second Chance' add-ons are available for Classic only.
programs.notes: Targets: Phase 1 10% ($5,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). 4 minimum trading days in each phase. Unlimited time. Leverage 1:100 forex, 1:30 metals/oil/indices, 1:2 crypto. Daily loss 5% of start-of-day balance (5 PM EST). 50K price is SECONDARY (see uncertain).

programs.name: Pro (2-Phase, Weekly or Daily Rewards)
programs.consistency_rule: 45% in Phase 1 and Phase 2 (best day at most 45% of total profit); none on funded accounts
programs.profit_split: 90% with Weekly Rewards; 60% with Daily Rewards (chosen at checkout)
programs.payout_frequency: weekly (one scheduled payout per week) or daily/on demand, chosen at checkout
programs.payout_rules_note: A reward can be requested once the account is at least 1% above the initial balance. The challenge fee is NOT credited back on Pro. Pro Weekly funded accounts must also respect a 20% margin-usage cap.
programs.notes: Targets: Phase 1 10% ($5,000), Phase 2 8% ($4,000). No minimum trading days stated by FunderPro, but its blog says 3 days are effectively needed to satisfy the consistency rule (third-party sites list 3). Leverage 1:100 forex, 1:30 metals/oil/indices, 1:2 crypto. 50K price is SECONDARY (see uncertain).

news_trading: Restricted: allowed in all challenge phases; on funded accounts no trade may be entered within 2 minutes before or after high-impact news unless the account has the Swing add-on
ea_bots_allowed: Allowed, restricted: you must own the EA/bot (and its source code, per the T&Cs); EAs for tick scalping, rollover scalping or HFT and anything exploiting platform gaps or latency are prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: only between your own accounts; copying trades or signals between different people is prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Overnight allowed. Weekend holding only with the Swing Account add-on (+10% of fee, reduced leverage); without it all positions, including crypto, must be closed by Friday 16:30 EST or the challenge fails
restricted_countries_note: Restricted: Afghanistan, Belarus, Central African Republic, DR Congo, Cuba, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Mali, Myanmar, North Korea, Somalia, Sudan, South Sudan, Syria, Russia, Donetsk/Zaporizhzhia/Luhansk/Kherson/Crimea/Sevastopol regions of Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen. US is not on the list, but MT5, cTrader and the Instant program are not available to US residents (TradeLocker challenges only).

current_public_promo.discount: 15% off (limited time, no end date given)
current_public_promo.applies_to: Pro challenge only, per FunderPro's Pro challenge page

affiliate_program.notes: Paid weekly on Thursdays in USDC (ERC-20) when over $50. No approval step (accept the terms in the dashboard); 18+ and an existing registered user. Affiliate terms exclude residents/nationals of 'Restricted Jurisdictions' as listed in FunderPro's FAQ; Serbia is not on that list, but FunderPro does not explicitly state that Serbian residents can join. FunderPro may change rates without notice.

recent_changes_2026.change: Trustpilot placed a warning on FunderPro's profile and the rating is shown as unavailable due to a guidelines breach; FunderPro published a response on 2026-01-19
